title: Release ImageKit — microinteractions & before/after hero assets for changelog post
creator: Ava Patel
description: Create a pack of hero and inline imagery for the upcoming release blog that showcases new quickstart/onboarding UX. Focus on before/after UI comparisons, microinteraction GIFs (looping, <3s), and accessible static fallbacks. Deliverables must include light/dark variants, colorblind-safe palette, and export-ready files for web and social channels.
acceptance_criteria: Hero composite (1200x628) with annotated callout pins and two states (before/after) exported as layered SVG and flattened PNG 2x

Three inline microinteraction GIFs (max 2.5s, 24fps) demonstrating (1) quickstart flow, (2) auto-fill + validation, (3) prefix KV-cache visual feedback — each with PNG static fallback and descriptive alt text
Before/after slider set: pair of high-res screenshots (2560x1440) with masking assets and recommended overlay captions
Design tokens and color palette notes included; WCAG AA contrast for text on hero variants
Delivery includes Figma link, Drive folder with exports, and a short motion spec (duration/easing) for engineers
